description: Workbook relationships, shared strings, and multi-sheet tables should render deterministically.
notes: The converter splits offset sub-tables into compact region tables while the reference builder emits one sheet-wide table with absolute column padding. The eval harness normalizes fully-empty rows/columns on both sides (normalize_table) and uses containment-based many-to-one pairing (run_eval.py many_to_one_table_similarity), so the metric compares cell semantics rather than layout representation. table_similarity measured 0.8531 after the <row r="N"> fix; threshold set to ~90% of that.
